column3: The object and purpose of this Part shall be –

(a)
to  provide  a  platform  through  a  recognized
market  operator  for  sale  and  purchase  of
unlisted securities in Sri Lanka to local and
overseas  investors  in  a  transparent  manner;

(b)
to  facilitate  the  disclosure  of  information
relating  to  unlisted  securities  to  local  and
market operator in a transparent manner.
